question.text: A solution of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CrO</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></math> in amyl alcohol has a....colour

solution.text: Chromium peroxide <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><msub><mi>CrO</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></mfenced></math> is a very unstable deep blue compound. It is soluble in water, but rapidly breaks down, and soluble as well as stable in solvents such as diethyl ether, ethyl acetate, amyl alcohol and its esters.
